await (async (page)=>{ const checks=[]; for(const width of [320,390,768,1440]){ await page.setViewportSize({width,height:950}); for(const view of ['console','records','connections']){ await page.locator('[data-view="'+view+'"]').click(); checks.push(await page.evaluate(({width,view})=>({width,view,documentWidth:document.documentElement.scrollWidth,overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth}),{width,view})); }} await page.locator('[data-view=console]').click(); await page.locator('#pause').click(); const paused=await page.evaluate(()=>({motion:document.querySelector('#motion-physical').textContent,highlights:document.querySelectorAll('.fsm-flow [aria-current=step]').length,stop:document.querySelector('#safety-stop-confirmed').textContent})); await page.locator('#pause').click(); return {checks,paused}; })(page);
